key_insight: Factorial analysis identified HVOF settings yielding acceptable hardness, porosity, and oxide attributes for Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coatings on Ti6Al4V.
engineering_relevance: The reported settings—150 mm standoff, 25 g/min powder feed, 475 NLPM hydrogen, and 205 NLPM oxygen—provide a process-development reference for this coating–substrate combination.
method: Used a two-level full factorial design with 24 experimental runs.
Measured coating quality and applied ANOVA to quantify spray-parameter contributions.
Used Pareto analysis to assess parameter interaction effects.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports coating-property measurements across 24 runs but provides no numerical hardness, porosity, oxide content, or statistical effect sizes.
watch_item: Validate these settings on the intended spray equipment; the abstract does not establish transferability or service-performance improvements.
paper_title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
